title: Tag Assignment v1
description: Assignment of an audience tag to a subject — the tag_assignment_event of the audience-tagging framework, expressed as a ResolutionDecision profile so it inherits explainability, confidence/uncertainty, policy veto, reversibility and audit. The subject is referenced through a tokenized/masked id (never raw), and CONSTRAINTS-family tags gate activation via the policy polytope.

subject_ref.description: Tokenized/masked subject id (e.g. a chameleon token), never a raw identifier.

masking_decision_ref.description: The masking decision that tokenized the subject for this realm.

evidence_refs.description: Pointers to the signals/witnesses that justify the assignment (auditable for bias/ethics review).

policy_verdict.description: Activation gate. A CONSTRAINTS-family tag (or forbidden mixture) can veto regardless of confidence.

gated_by_constraint.description: tag_id of the CONSTRAINTS tag that gated activation, if any.

reversible.description: Assignments are revocable; revocation appends a ledger entry (not a delete).

expiry_ts.description: Tags decay; INTENT_STAGE especially is volatile.
